[[Master Engineer Jakumba]] is a talented designer of siege weaponry. He is first encountered in Istan, where he was approached by the [[Vabbian military]] for employment. Later on, he creates the [[Shard of Brilliance]] for the [[Order of Whispers]] to use in [[Ravenheart Gloom]].
